messages.content: You solve SQLite query tasks. You have an ordinary SQL execution/check tool through this JSON protocol. You may check or directly submit; at most four turns including final submission. Hidden databases evaluate general correctness. Use the task obligations as authoritative. message.content: {"action":"check","sql":"SELECT accounts_407.id, COALESCE(events_407.state, 'NONE') AS state FROM accounts_407 JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM events_407 WHERE at <= 4 GROUP BY account_id) AS latest_event ON accounts_407.id = latest_event.account_id JOIN events_407 ON events_407.id = latest_event.max_id AND events_407.at <= 4 WHERE accounts_407.active = 1 ORDER BY accounts_407.id;"}
